criteria_results.text: Sending from mobile must not invoke OpenCode context compaction as a fallback for session title generation, including when a projectless session is absent from the selected project's scoped refresh result.
criteria_results.notes: The device rendered a blank user bubble and a large Goal/Progress/Key Decisions assistant card because mobile called session.summarize after the send. Criterion c17 was added after this smoke failure.

criteria_results.text: Internal OpenCode compaction request and summary records must not render as blank user bubbles or assistant transcript responses in mobile chat.
criteria_results.notes: Internal compaction request and summary records were rendered as ordinary chat turns. Criterion c18 was added after this smoke failure.

criteria_results.text: Before a mobile prompt is forwarded to OpenCode, the API must start and await the session's event bridge so the completed turn persists and broadcasts to the desktop client even after an API restart.
criteria_results.notes: The engine accepted and completed the mobile prompt, but the API database and desktop client never received it because no global engine event subscription had been started after the API restart. Criterion c19 was added after this smoke failure.

criteria_results.text: After prompt_async accepts a mobile turn, mobile must refresh until the new assistant turn is observable so a connected-but-filtered event stream cannot leave the response invisible.
criteria_results.notes: The engine response existed, but mobile refreshed once before the async turn completed and never displayed the answer. Criterion c20 was added after this smoke failure.

process_issues.description: The mobile send path assumed an immediate post-prompt_async refresh could observe a later assistant response.
process_issues.detected_by: Direct engine transcript inspection showed the completed assistant turn while the mobile UI remained unchanged.

process_issues.description: The API restart left desktop persistence dependent on an event bridge that was only started by desktop-originated session streaming.
process_issues.detected_by: The engine transcript contained the mobile turn while agent_session_messages retained only the original desktop turns.

failure_output: User: still does not show in desktop client, and the agent never responded. Direct engine inspection: the assistant had responded, but the API DB, desktop client, and mobile view had not converged.
suggested_follow_up: Require every async mobile-send smoke to assert the same unique turn in engine, API transcript storage, desktop UI, and mobile UI after a fresh API restart; tracked by #1287.
